content.short: ChainPro is a zero-fee, non-custodial trading terminal aimed at professional traders.
content.description: ChainPro is a non-custodial trading terminal with no platform fee, keeping assets in the user's own wallet and not an exchange account. It offers advanced order types and a feature it calls Swarms for coordinated execution. The terminal is live on Solana, Base, Ethereum mainnet, Hyperliquid, BNB Chain, Abstract and Arbitrum, with an iOS app alongside the web interface.
content.meta: A non-custodial terminal for active traders that charges no platform fee.
